For an unoffset sinusoid Vrms=Vpeak/sqrt(2), Vpp=2*Vpeak; explicitly denies universal applicability to arbitrary waveforms.

Initial flux, phase, temperature, contacts and probe conditions can change transients; properly conditional rather than asserting a measured cause.
